prompt: A surreal digital illustration with a top-down diving perspective. A giant luminescent octopus glides through a pitch-black trench, its tendrils unfurling into galaxy dust and constellations. A tiny diver with a warm yellow headlamp hovers in the center of the frame, dwarfed by the creature, gazing straight down into the abyss. Dramatic scale contrast, deep midnight blues fading into violet, phosphorescent teal accents along the tentacles, drifting marine snow catching the light. Dreamlike, meditative, slightly unsettling atmosphere. 1:1
